user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for ChatGPT search answers; sites opted out won't appear in search results

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Pages submitted as ads; data not used for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: OAI-AdsBot / Disallow: / (robots.txt; page visits only occur for submitted ads)

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training content for generative AI foundation models; improving model usefulness and safety
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for potential training data; disallow indicates content should not be used for model training

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs when users request web page visits
user_agents.scope: User-initiated fetch for live responses; not automatic web crawling; robots.txt rules may not apply
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply to user-triggered requests; use OAI-SearchBot rules for automatic crawl opt-out

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / or Crawl-delay directive in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Support Claude AI users accessing websites during user-initiated queries
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to Claude questions
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent content retrieval

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search result quality and relevance for Claude users
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for search indexing and optimization
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent indexing

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Building Google Search indexes and finding information for Google search
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing, images, video, news, and Discover

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawling images for Google Images and Google Search image features
user_agents.scope: Image URLs and favicons used in Google Search, Images, Video, and Discover

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawling videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video content for Google Search video features and products dependent on videos

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Google News product and news.google.com
user_agents.scope: News content for Google News product including news.google.com and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawling product information for Google Shopping
user_agents.scope: Shopping content for Google Shopping surfaces including Shopping tab in Search

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Testing and validation for Google Search testing tools like Rich Result Test
user_agents.scope: Site content for Search Console tools like URL inspection and Rich Result Test

user_agents.name: GoogleOther

user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content for one-off crawls, R&D, and various product team needs

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling for various Google product teams
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for various product team research and development

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video crawling for various Google product teams
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs for various product team research and development

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawling for building Vertex AI Agents requested by site owners
user_agents.scope: Content crawled for site owners requesting crawls for Vertex AI Agents

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for Gemini models and grounding in Vertex AI
user_agents.scope: Content for training Gemini models and grounding with Google Search

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result crawling; not used for AI training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: PerplexityBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; can also whitelist via IP ranges at https://www.perplexity.com/perplexitybot.json

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions within Perplexity when users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web page fetches to provide accurate answers; generally ignores robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Configure WAF rules or IP filtering using ranges from https://www.perplexity.com/perplexity-user.json

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for search results in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to index content for Apple search features
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow: / in robots.txt under User-agent: Applebot; or disallow specific paths

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determine usage of crawled content for training Apple foundation models and generative AI
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; processes data crawled by Applebot for AI training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt to opt out of AI training

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Content discovery for Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts only
user_agents.opt_out: Does not respect robots.txt; limited to Apple Podcasts registered content crawling

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
